name: web-components-factory
description: Adaptive Card Component with TDD approach using web-components.ts

scripts.ci: npm run type-check && npm run test:run && npm run build
scripts.claude:plan: mkdir -p docs/plans && echo 'Create implementation plan' && ls -la docs/plans/
scripts.claude:review: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run test:run && echo '✅ Review complete'
scripts.claude:check: npm run type-check && npm run lint && echo '✅ Code check complete'
scripts.claude:clean: rm -rf dist coverage .vitest && echo '🧹 Cleaned build artifacts'
scripts.claude:docs: mkdir -p docs/knowledge && echo '📚 Documentation structure:' && ls -la docs/
scripts.claude:verify: npm run ci && echo '✅ All checks passed'
scripts.claude:quick: npm run type-check && npm run test:run
scripts.claude:all: npm run claude:check && npm run test:run && npm run build && echo '🎉 Full pipeline complete'
